summary: Wrote a 7-phase plan for the dead-command-recommendation lint and fix. The lint is written first and deliberately red so its own output is the authoritative worklist (188 lines / 92 files / 12 extensions, independently re-measured this dispatch), then a fixture suite proves it fires, then the structural command-output.md template-assignment remap, then three extension-scoped fix waves (core 42/27, founder 102/36, remaining ten 44/29), then gate 24 wiring plus redeploy to RESULT=landed_verify_clean. The NET-SIZE requirement is discharged in writing: neither lint-routing-wiring.sh nor lint-contract-compliance.sh is a natural host, and additive cost is held down by reusing lint-corpus-scan-lib.sh rather than reimplementing file collection.

artifacts.summary: Phased implementation plan, validated clean by validate-artifact.sh.
